model_notes: Rules r-0034, r-0035 and r-0027 cover units whose coverage status (fully or partially covered by Rent Ordinance) cannot be tested from parcel data, so a status_not_in_data condition is used. Local-law deference (state rules yielding to stricter local ordinances) was left out as instructed.
